purpose: Teach: マリオ/マーティン/スティーブン/コリン/ティム/アレックス/ニコラ/アーサー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家でスーパーマリオやってたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you playing Super Mario at home the other day.
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Casual opening. Slight knowing smile in the voice—catching him in something small and mundane. Even pace, relaxed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でマーティン・ルーサー・キング習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You studied Martin Luther King in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quick verbal pivot. Deflecting with a question that mirrors her tone right back at her. A small challenge disguised as curiosity. Slight emphasis on her name—turning it back on her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、スティーブン・キングのホラー読んでたな
lines.en: Riku, I remember you reading Stephen King horror novels.
lines.style: Sharper now. Still teasing but with an edge—she's escalating the game. Slight drawl on 'Stephen King' to emphasize the name-match absurdity. Eyebrow-raise in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、映画でコリン・ファース観てたろ、桜
lines.en: You watched Colin Firth movies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Staying calm. Matching her escalation without getting flustered. Deliberate, even tone. No rush—he's figured out the pattern and he's playing along now, confident.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ティム・バートン監督の映画好きだったな
lines.en: Riku, you're really into Tim Burton movies.
lines.style: Slightly breathless—she's catching the game but not quite ready to concede. Still pressing. Slight acceleration on 'Tim Burton' to keep the rhythm going. A hint of impressed despite herself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゲームでアレックスってキャラ使ってたな、桜
lines.en: You used to play as a character named Alex in that game, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter now. The hint of a smile underneath. He's won the exchange and he knows it—this answer is the one that lands. Measured, almost gentle. Final point, delivered without gloating.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、科学でニコラ・テスラの発明調べてたな
lines.en: Riku, I know you researched Nikola Tesla's inventions for science class.
lines.style: Last attempt. Determined but slightly desperate. Faster pace—running out of ammunition and she knows it. Still trying to land a hit. Slight strain underneath the confidence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英語の教科書でアーサー王伝説読んでたろ、桜
lines.en: You read the King Arthur legend in your English textbook, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Slow, deliberate, with quiet triumph underneath. He stretches the final question just slightly—letting her hear that he's won. No cruelty in it, just a soft certainty. The closer.
